coverage_note: Issuer/FDA-sourced scheduled catalysts, each re-fetched and quote-checked by biotech_review.py within the last 7 days. Coverage is partial: an absent name is not evidence of no upcoming catalyst.

events.known_data: DECLARATION enrollment is complete and LIBERTY is fully dosed (Q2 2026 release). No efficacy data reported.
events.new_information: Top-line VYD2311 data expected around the end of Q3 2026; the issuer then plans a BLA via either traditional or accelerated approval depending on how DECLARATION is unblinded.
events.read_throughs: 'Around the end of Q3' is the issuer's wording; it can slip past 2026-09-30, after which this entry drops rather than being re-dated without a new source. No read-through to other names is asserted.
events.source_quote: Invivyd continues to expect top-line data from the VYD2311 program around the end of Q3 2026.
events.stage: Pivotal (DECLARATION) and LIBERTY studies, top-line pending

events.known_data: FDA previously granted INO-3107 orphan drug and breakthrough therapy designations; the issuer says the FDA had not discussed its preliminary comment on accelerated-approval eligibility and that feedback on the confirmatory trial design would be forthcoming.
events.new_information: Issuer reports the late-cycle review meeting and all scheduled pre-licensure inspections are complete, toward an October 30, 2026 PDUFA target action date.
events.read_throughs: A binary regulatory decision on the issuer's lead asset; the issuer states it is preparing a commercial launch. No read-through to other names is asserted.
events.source_quote: The FDA's review of the BLA for INO-3107 continues to advance under the agency's accelerated approval program toward a PDUFA target action date of October 30, 2026.
events.stage: BLA under FDA review (accelerated approval program)

events.known_data: No clinical efficacy data reported; the issuer describes continued enrollment of the first cohort.
events.new_information: Topline data from the first cohort of the Phase 1/2 trial expected in Q4 2026.
events.read_throughs: An early first-cohort readout on the issuer's lead clinical program. No read-through to other names is asserted.
events.source_quote: Topline data from first cohort of Phase 1/2 trial expected in Q4-2026

events.known_data: LUGANO, the first of the two pivotal Phase 3 wet AMD trials, reported topline data on 2026-08-17; the issuer describes stable retinal anatomy through Week 56.
events.new_information: Topline data from LUCIA, the second wet AMD pivotal Phase 3 trial, expected in Q4 2026; the issuer anticipates potentially filing an NDA in 1H 2027.
events.read_throughs: The second pivotal readout gates the planned NDA. The DME trials (COMO, CAPRI) read out separately in Q4 2027 and are outside this window. No read-through to other names is asserted.
events.source_quote: The Company remains on track to report topline data from the second wet AMD pivotal Phase 3 LUCIA trial in the fourth quarter of 2026.

events.known_data: Interim data on six patients (two dose cohorts) presented at ASGCT: PVC count fell in all patients, mean -64% from baseline; no dose-limiting toxicities. EMA PRIME designation May 2026.
events.new_information: Additional interim RIDGE-1 data expected in Q4 2026; enrollment needed to characterise dose response is complete.
events.read_throughs: An update on a small open-label cohort, not a controlled readout. The issuer separately plans a TN-201 regulatory update in Q4 2026. No read-through to other names is asserted.
events.source_quote: Tenaya expects to report additional interim data from the RIDGE-1 clinical trial in the fourth quarter of 2026.

events.known_data: No efficacy readout from TibuSHIELD has been reported. A separate Phase 2 in systemic sclerosis (TibuSURE) reads out in H1 2027.
events.new_information: TibuSHIELD completed enrollment with 247 participants, above target; topline data expected in Q4 2026.
events.read_throughs: First controlled efficacy data for the issuer's lead asset. No read-through to other names is asserted.
events.source_quote: Topline data from TibuSHIELD are expected in the fourth quarter of 2026.
